summary.text: Father of Prothous (`prothous-magnesia`), captain of the Magnetes who dwelt about Peneius and forested Pelion with forty black ships in the Catalogue of Ships.

story.text: Homer names Tenthredon only as the father of swift Prothous when Nestor musters the Magnetes beside the fair-flowing Peneius and Pelion, covered with waving forests — forty black ships under the son of Tenthredon.
